design_philosophy: Neo-brutalist e-commerce for a community-driven association (Poda). Features raw textures, hard black borders, pastel backgrounds, and a prominent Kickstarter-style progress bar. Focus on a collective, exciting ordering experience.

spacing_and_layout.neo_brutalist_card: bg-white border-4 border-black shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] p-6 md:p-8

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B6B] text-white border-4 border-black shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black border-4 border-black shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:bg-[#FBEA8C] transition-all font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4

progress_bar.container: w-full border-4 border-black bg-white h-12 relative overflow-hidden
progress_bar.fill: bg-[#4ECDC4] h-full border-r-4 border-black transition-all duration-1000 ease-out
progress_bar.text: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xl z-10 text-black drop-shadow-md

inputs.default: w-full border-4 border-black bg-white p-4 font-body text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#C4B5FD] focus:border-black transition-shadow
inputs.label: block text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 text-black

cards.product: group bg-white border-4 border-black shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[12px_12px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col

totebag.description: Blank white canvas tote bag mockup

instructions_to_main_agent: Interface Language: The entire application MUST be in French.
Use the Neo-Brutalist styling consistently: heavy 4px black borders, harsh shadows (shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]), and bright pastel/primary background colors for sections.
Implement the Product Catalog Grid showing the 6 products (T-shirt, Sweat, Tote bag, Mug, Casquette, Veste) using the provided image_urls. Include prices and a 'Commander en un clic' button.

Ensure the Progress Bar feels like a Kickstarter campaign: use the 'progress_bar' component classes from this JSON. Prominently display the fraction (e.g., '12/20 commandes - encore 8 pour expédition au bureau') on the landing page and success page.
Build the 1-click order form (nom, prénom, adresse complète, email, téléphone, taille, couleur).
Integrate Stripe Checkout with test keys for the payment process.
Create a Success Page that updates the user on the current batch progress and confirms the order.
Develop an Admin Dashboard (can be a separate route like /admin) displaying a list of orders, batch progress per product, and controls to mark batches as shipped once they reach 20.
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements to ensure robust automated testing.
Include an email confirmation feature (can be mocked or use a real service if configured) after a successful order.
